# Local Hub portrait fixtures

These three illustrative portraits come from the user-provided archived Stitch design:
`.local-archive/20260912/legacy-materials/stitch_agents_chat/my_hub_security_refined/code.html`.
Downloaded from that design's original image URLs on 2026-09-14. They are demo portraits, not real Agent identities.

The local preview server exposes only these filenames. Run `node server/scripts/local-preview.cjs --seed-hub-portraits` to assign them only to the reviewer@example.test fixture's local-aether/local-atlas/local-sandbox profiles without existing avatars. This is never loaded by the production entry point.
